key_safety.text: Most common AEs: diarrhea (47%), nausea (31%), pyrexia (39%), headache (38%), fatigue (34%); fluid retention including peripheral edema (26%) and pleural effusion (17%). Most common grade 3/4 AEs were hematologic (neutropenia/thrombocytopenia ~45-80%, anemia 18-66%).

citations.quote: The most common AEs included gastrointestinal events such as diarrhea (47%), nausea (31%), abdominal pain (25%), and vomiting (22%) and constitutional events such as pyrexia (39%), headache (38%), fatigue (34%), asthenia (22%) and anorexia (15%). Fluid retention events such as peripheral edema (26%) and pleural effusion (17%) were also common.
The most common grade 3/4 AEs were hematologic, including neutropenia and thrombocytopenia in approximately 45-80% of patients, and anemia in 18-66%.
